version.changelog:
vn-weijialiao 1.0.1 — Kết hợp thêm liệu 18+ và nạp liệu lore

- Thêm kỹ thuật "Nạp liệu (Lore)": hướng dẫn tích hợp thiết lập thế giới quan vào truyện qua hội thoại, xung đột và tiết lộ dần.
- Mở rộng mô tả kỹ thuật 微加料 (18+) với các pattern chi tiết (tiêu đề, ear whisper, hành động thay thế, phản ứng song phương...).
- Bổ sung bảng checklist kiểm tra chất lượng nạp liệu và giữ nguyên plot.
- Cập nhật description và bố cục lại SKILL.md cho rõ ràng, logic hơn.
- Không thay đổi cách viết file hay chức năng cốt lõi.

llm.summary: This is a disclosed adult fiction transformation skill with no code execution, network use, credential access, or persistence, though users should apply it only to clearly eligible adult content.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem, shell, network, credential, browser, or external service access; its behavior is limited to text transformation instructions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single Markdown skill file with no bundled scripts or dependencies, but its frontmatter description contains unescaped quotes that may make metadata parsing fragile.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Some triggers are broad, including every chapter title and mild affectionate actions, which could over-apply the transformation if a user invokes the skill without clear adult-content intent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background execution, privilege escalation, memory writes, scheduled tasks, or tool modification instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's stated purpose is to convert clean fiction chapters into 18+ erotic-adjacent Chinese/Vietnamese rewrite patterns while preserving plot and adding lore; the adult-content transformation is explicit and purpose-aligned, not hidden.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you specifically want a Vietnamese/Chinese adult-fiction rewrite helper. Use it on content where all characters and context are clearly appropriate for adult sexualized rewriting, and review outputs carefully because the triggers can intensify mild scenes.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: The Vietnamese/Chinese locale is apparent from the skill name, metadata, and examples; this is expected for the stated rewrite task, though users should know it is locale-specific.
[SQP-1] expected: The 'Mọi chapter' trigger applies to chapter title suffixes and fits the skill's disclosed batch chapter rewrite purpose; it is broad but not hidden or security-sensitive.
[SQP-1] expected: The catch-all for mild affectionate actions can over-apply erotic replacement, but it is plainly part of the disclosed adult transformation behavior rather than deceptive or privileged behavior.
